title.narrative: Transition for Inclusive Development in Eastern Congo (TRIDE)

description.narrative: Objectives: Alleviation of insecurity and instability by promoting economic development and access to markets and land in Eastern DRC.•Outcome 1: Access to land by smallholders is increased, security of tenure for smallholders is improved and land-related conflicts are reduced; •Outcome 2: Integrated Water Resources Management is strengthened to promote resilient agricultural systems in North and South Kivu;•Outcome 3: The local economy is revitalized through inclusive and profitable value chains and the development of market systems.
•(Vulnerable) smallholder farmers and their families in rural villages,•Market actors,•(Local) Public authorities.

description.narrative: A social compromise on an inter-communal conflict refers to an agreement reached under the facilitation of a local authority by the conflicting parties at the end of mediation/peaceful conflict resolution. title.narrative: Output 1.1 Provincial land intervention strategies are developed and adopted by the provincial governments of North and South Kivu
Level of development of local intervention strategies

description.narrative: Indicator is reformulated after MTR. Main steps to reach the strategy are : 1° inventory of land assets (public properties, public domain and the private domain of public persons, land concessions and the enjoyment area of ​​local communities), 2° examination of the compatibility of current land uses with the objectives of the local or provincial development plan, (2024) 3° setting of prioritized and concerted objectives, 4° carrying out territorial animation (mobilization and synergy of territorial stakeholders in order to facilitate the achievement of objectives), 5° choice of land intervention methods and land operators, 6° selection of land action tools, carrying out land animation (consultation and awareness-raising of stakeholders concerned by land actions), 2025 7° a priori evaluation of the land strategy (land-based assessment and assessment of the impact on biodiversity).

comment.narrative: The process is in progress.
